{{Short description|Chinese physicist}}
{{about|the physicist|the singer|Lexie Liu}}

'''Liu Baixin''' {{zh|t=柳百新}}; born 10 June 1935) is a Chinese physicist.

Upon graduating from [[Tsinghua University]] in 1961, Liu began teaching there.<ref>{{cite news |title=Liu Baixin |url=https://www.mse.tsinghua.edu.cn/mseen/info/1018/1081.htm |access-date=21 February 2022 |publisher=Tsinghua University}}</ref> He was elected a fellow of the [[American Physical Society]] in 1998, "[f]or outstanding contributions to the understanding of amorphous alloy formation by ion beam mixing."<ref>{{cite news |title=APS fellow archive |url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=L&year=2021&unit_id=&institution= |access-date=21 February 2022 |publisher=American Physical Society}}</ref> In 2001, Liu was elected an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Liu Baixin 柳百新 |url=https://www.chinavitae.com/biography/Liu_Baixin/summary |access-date=21 February 2022 |publisher=China Vitae}}</ref>
